cf_1366_a.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_1366_a.raw_spec: With a sticks and b diamonds, a shovel consumes2 sticks+1 diamond and a sword consumes1 stick+2 diamonds. Maximize total tools.
cf_1366_a.l3_spec:
With a sticks and b diamonds, a shovel consumes2 sticks+1 diamond and a sword consumes1 stick+2 diamonds. Maximize total tools.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: A sword consumes THREE diamonds instead of two; its stick cost and shovel recipe remain unchanged.
cf_1366_a.l3_change: A sword consumes THREE diamonds instead of two; its stick cost and shovel recipe remain unchanged.
cf_1366_a.proof_sketch: Raw optimum is min(a,b,floor((a+b)/3)). For L3, x total tools with h shovels require x+h sticks and3x-2h diamonds, giving the feasible integer interval max(0,ceil((3x-b)/2))<=h<=min(x,a-x). Feasibility is monotone in x, allowing binary search. The oracle enumerates every pair of nonnegative shovel/sword counts.

cf_1475_d.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_1475_d.raw_spec: Remove application occurrences to free at least m memory units while minimizing their total convenience costs b_i in{1,2}. Return-1 if infeasible.
cf_1475_d.l3_spec:
Remove application occurrences to free at least m memory units while minimizing their total convenience costs b_i in{1,2}. Return-1 if infeasible.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Important applications with b_i=2 are PROTECTED and may not be removed. Other requirements are unchanged.
cf_1475_d.l3_change: Important applications with b_i=2 are PROTECTED and may not be removed. Other requirements are unchanged.
cf_1475_d.proof_sketch: Within each cost category, taking its largest-memory applications dominates every other subset of the same size. Enumerate how many cost2 items to take and binary-search the necessary prefix of cost1 items. L3 omits the protected category. The oracle enumerates all application subsets and checks memory, cost, and protection directly.

cf_1525_d.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_1525_d.raw_spec: Move seated people so all initially occupied seats become free; each move from i to an empty j costs|i-j|. Initially occupied count is at most half of n. Minimize total time.
cf_1525_d.l3_spec:
Move seated people so all initially occupied seats become free; each move from i to an empty j costs|i-j|. Initially occupied count is at most half of n. Minimize total time.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Every move must go STRICTLY TO THE RIGHT (j>i). Return-1 if the goal is impossible.
cf_1525_d.l3_change: Every move must go STRICTLY TO THE RIGHT (j>i). Return-1 if the goal is impossible.
cf_1525_d.proof_sketch: Triangle inequality permits replacing any movement chain by direct assignment to a final initially empty seat without increasing time. Crossing assignments can be uncrossed at no greater absolute-distance cost, including with rightward feasibility. DP matches ordered people to a subsequence of ordered empty seats. The oracle enumerates all injective assignments without an ordering assumption.

cf_272_b.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_272_b.raw_spec: Count pairs i<j with equal f(a_i), where f(0)=0,f(2x)=f(x),f(2x+1)=f(x)+1 (binary set-bit count).
cf_272_b.l3_spec:
Count pairs i<j with equal f(a_i), where f(0)=0,f(2x)=f(x),f(2x+1)=f(x)+1 (binary set-bit count).
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Count pairs whose set-bit counts differ by EXACTLY ONE instead of being equal.
cf_272_b.l3_change: Count pairs whose set-bit counts differ by EXACTLY ONE instead of being equal.
cf_272_b.proof_sketch: The recurrence defines popcount. Equal weights contribute combinations within buckets, while difference1 contributes products of adjacent buckets. The oracle computes weights through repeated integer division and directly tests all index pairs.

cf_343_b.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_343_b.raw_spec: Decide whether wires can be untangled; in the crossing-sign representation this is equivalent to reducing the whole string by removing adjacent equal signs.
cf_343_b.l3_spec:
Decide whether wires can be untangled; in the crossing-sign representation this is equivalent to reducing the whole string by removing adjacent equal signs.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Use the alternative cancellation rule: only adjacent OPPOSITE signs may cancel. OutputYES exactly when the entire string can disappear.
cf_343_b.l3_change: Use the alternative cancellation rule: only adjacent OPPOSITE signs may cancel. OutputYES exactly when the entire string can disappear.
cf_343_b.proof_sketch: Raw equal-pair reduction has a unique irreducible result and is computed by a stack. Under opposite-pair reduction, each step removes one of each sign, and a nonempty mixture always has an opposite adjacent pair; full reduction is possible exactly when counts match. The independent oracle repeatedly scans and erases a legal pair.

cf_438_a.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
cf_438_a.raw_spec: Remove every graph vertex exactly once. Removing vertex i costs the sum of values of its still-present neighbors. Minimize the total cost over removal orders.
cf_438_a.l3_spec:
Remove every graph vertex exactly once. Removing vertex i costs the sum of values of its still-present neighbors. Minimize the total cost over removal orders.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: MAXIMIZE total removal cost instead of minimizing it.
cf_438_a.l3_change: MAXIMIZE total removal cost instead of minimizing it.
cf_438_a.proof_sketch: Each edge contributes the value of whichever endpoint is removed later. Descending vertex-value order simultaneously attains min endpoint value on every edge; ascending order attains max. The independent oracle enumerates all removal permutations and directly sums later-neighbor edge costs.

atcoder_abc179_c.source_name: p02548 AtCoder Beginner Contest 179 - A x B + C
atcoder_abc179_c.original_source_identity: deepmind/code_contests:train:493:p02548 AtCoder Beginner Contest 179 - A x B + C
atcoder_abc179_c.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
atcoder_abc179_c.raw_spec: Count positive integer triples(A,B,C) satisfying A*B+C=N.
atcoder_abc179_c.l3_spec:
Count positive integer triples(A,B,C) satisfying A*B+C=N.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Allow C=0 as well: A and B remain strictly positive, while C becomes nonnegative.
atcoder_abc179_c.l3_change: Allow C=0 as well: A and B remain strictly positive, while C becomes nonnegative.
atcoder_abc179_c.proof_sketch: For each positive A, eligible B count is floor((N-1)/A) for positive C, and floor(N/A) for nonnegative C. C is uniquely determined. The oracle explicitly enumerates all A,B<=N and tests the product predicate.

atcoder_abc095_c.source_name: p03371 AtCoder Beginner Contest 095 - Half and Half
atcoder_abc095_c.original_source_identity: deepmind/code_contests:train:499:p03371 AtCoder Beginner Contest 095 - Half and Half
atcoder_abc095_c.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
atcoder_abc095_c.raw_spec: Buy whole A-pizzas, whole B-pizzas, or pairs of half-A/half-B pizzas. Meet demands X and Y at minimum cost; surplus pizzas are allowed.
atcoder_abc095_c.l3_spec:
Buy whole A-pizzas, whole B-pizzas, or pairs of half-A/half-B pizzas. Meet demands X and Y at minimum cost; surplus pizzas are allowed.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Surplus pizzas are FORBIDDEN: the final A and B quantities must equal X and Y exactly.
atcoder_abc095_c.l3_change: Surplus pizzas are FORBIDDEN: the final A and B quantities must equal X and Y exactly.
atcoder_abc095_c.proof_sketch: Buying k pairs of mixed pizzas gives cost2Ck+A*max(0,X-k)+B*max(0,Y-k), a piecewise linear function with breakpoints0,min(X,Y),max(X,Y). Exact quantities restrict k<=min(X,Y). The oracle independently checks every integer k in the allowed finite interval.

hackerearth_max_min.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_max_min.raw_spec: Select exactly K input occurrences and minimize max(selected)-min(selected).
hackerearth_max_min.l3_spec:
Select exactly K input occurrences and minimize max(selected)-min(selected).
SEMANTIC CHANGE: MAXIMIZE the selected spread instead of minimizing it.
hackerearth_max_min.l3_change: MAXIMIZE the selected spread instead of minimizing it.
hackerearth_max_min.proof_sketch: An optimum minimum-spread set can be chosen as a contiguous K-window after sorting, because any skipped interior value can replace an extreme without increasing range. For maximum spread and K>=2, include global min/max; K=1 has spread0. The oracle independently enumerates every K-subset.

hackerearth_time_land.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_time_land.raw_spec: Select any subset of slip indices, including empty, to maximize the sum. Consecutive selected indices must differ by at least K+1, i.e. have at least K intervening unselected slips.
hackerearth_time_land.l3_spec:
Select any subset of slip indices, including empty, to maximize the sum. Consecutive selected indices must differ by at least K+1, i.e. have at least K intervening unselected slips.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Require selected indices to differ by at least K+2 instead of K+1.
hackerearth_time_land.l3_change: Require selected indices to differ by at least K+2 instead of K+1.
hackerearth_time_land.proof_sketch: An optimal prefix either omits its last slip or includes it and combines its value with the best prefix ending before the exclusion window. The recurrence changes the predecessor index by one for L3. The independent oracle enumerates subsets and explicitly checks all consecutive selected-index gaps.

hackerearth_cost_of_data.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_cost_of_data.raw_spec: Insert distinct lowercase words into a prefix trie with one root; output its total node count.
hackerearth_cost_of_data.l3_spec:
Insert distinct lowercase words into a prefix trie with one root; output its total node count.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Store the words by sharing SUFFIXES instead of prefixes, equivalently insert reversed words into a trie.
hackerearth_cost_of_data.l3_change: Store the words by sharing SUFFIXES instead of prefixes, equivalently insert reversed words into a trie.
hackerearth_cost_of_data.proof_sketch: Each non-root trie node corresponds to exactly one distinct nonempty prefix. Reversal bijects prefixes of reversed words with suffixes of original words. The optimized program constructs nodes; the independent oracle explicitly extracts all prefixes/suffixes and deduplicates by linear comparisons.

hackerearth_monks_birthday.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_monks_birthday.raw_spec: Read T invitation-name lists. For each print all distinct names exactly once in lexicographic order.
hackerearth_monks_birthday.l3_spec:
Read T invitation-name lists. For each print all distinct names exactly once in lexicographic order.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Invite only names that occurred EXACTLY ONCE in the input list; names mentioned repeatedly are excluded. Maintain lexicographic output order.
hackerearth_monks_birthday.l3_change: Invite only names that occurred EXACTLY ONCE in the input list; names mentioned repeatedly are excluded. Maintain lexicographic output order.
hackerearth_monks_birthday.proof_sketch: A sorted frequency map implements both membership predicates. The independent oracle literally bubble-sorts all occurrences then counts complete equal-name runs and decides whether to emit them.

hackerearth_ankit_race.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_ankit_race.raw_spec: A team of exactly K distinct students has strength equal to its weakest member. Sum strengths over all K-subsets modulo1000000007; input strengths are distinct.
hackerearth_ankit_race.l3_spec:
A team of exactly K distinct students has strength equal to its weakest member. Sum strengths over all K-subsets modulo1000000007; input strengths are distinct.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Team strength equals the STRONGEST member instead of the weakest.
hackerearth_ankit_race.l3_change: Team strength equals the STRONGEST member instead of the weakest.
hackerearth_ankit_race.proof_sketch: In sorted order, a_i is the unique minimum of choose(N-i-1,K-1) teams, or maximum of choose(i,K-1) teams. Factorials and inverse factorials evaluate these weights modulo the prime. The oracle enumerates all subsets and computes the team extremum explicitly.

hackerearth_give_me_my_test.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_give_me_my_test.raw_spec: Randomly permute N test papers among their owners. Return modulo1000000007 the probability that the number of students receiving someone else paper lies in[L,R].
hackerearth_give_me_my_test.l3_spec:
Randomly permute N test papers among their owners. Return modulo1000000007 the probability that the number of students receiving someone else paper lies in[L,R].
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Apply[L,R] to the number of students receiving THEIR OWN paper instead.
hackerearth_give_me_my_test.l3_change: Apply[L,R] to the number of students receiving THEIR OWN paper instead.
hackerearth_give_me_my_test.proof_sketch: Exactly m displaced students can be chosen in C(N,m) ways and deranged in D_m ways, with D_m=(m-1)(D_(m-1)+D_(m-2)). Divide qualifying counts by N! modulo the prime. The oracle enumerates every permutation, counts fixed points directly, and divides observed qualifying counts by the observed total.

hackerearth_lexicographic_predecessor.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_lexicographic_predecessor.raw_spec: Output the lexicographic predecessor of each permutation of1..n. The lexicographically least input remains unchanged.
hackerearth_lexicographic_predecessor.l3_spec:
Output the lexicographic predecessor of each permutation of1..n. The lexicographically least input remains unchanged.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Output the lexicographic SUCCESSOR instead; the lexicographically greatest input remains unchanged.
hackerearth_lexicographic_predecessor.l3_change: Output the lexicographic SUCCESSOR instead; the lexicographically greatest input remains unchanged.
hackerearth_lexicographic_predecessor.proof_sketch: The optimized predecessor/successor locates the last improvable pivot, swaps with the closest feasible suffix value, and reverses the suffix (standard algorithm). The independent oracle enumerates all permutations from the first one, remembering the previous permutation or taking the next enumerated one upon reaching the input.

hackerearth_roys_life_cycle.independent_oracle: Different construction: exhaustive search, direct simulation, or literal pair/window enumeration.
hackerearth_roys_life_cycle.raw_spec: Read N days, exactly1440 actions E/S/C per day. Output the maximum coding(C) streak within any single day and the maximum coding streak across all days including boundaries.
hackerearth_roys_life_cycle.l3_spec:
Read N days, exactly1440 actions E/S/C per day. Output the maximum coding(C) streak within any single day and the maximum coding streak across all days including boundaries.
SEMANTIC CHANGE: Measure SLEEPING(S) streaks instead of coding(C) streaks.
hackerearth_roys_life_cycle.l3_change: Measure SLEEPING(S) streaks instead of coding(C) streaks.
hackerearth_roys_life_cycle.proof_sketch: One counter resets at each day boundary for the daily maximum; a second continues through boundaries for the global maximum. Non-target actions reset both. The oracle independently starts at every position and scans the entire target-character run, once per day and once in the concatenated log.
